04 · The artist

Art is where a thought becomes visible.

Shenali Rodrigo creates original acrylic paintings under BRUSH STROKES BY SHENIII. Her work moves between textured abstraction, nature, human stories and contemporary reinterpretations — using colour and surface to turn an ordinary image into something personal.

Each work is painted by hand and presented as an original piece. Selected works are available for purchase, while custom pieces can be created through commission.
